subject.title: Incomplete turn with tool call and payloads=0 is replayUnsafe and may poison session state

question: For replay-unsafe `tools>0/payloads=0` embedded turns, should OpenClaw retry/fail over selected safe cases, or keep the current fail-closed behavior and add durable quarantine/repair evidence?
rationale: Current source proves the failure mode, but the safe boundary is product and runtime policy because automatic retry can duplicate tool side effects while fail-closed behavior causes recurring message loss for real cron/channel users.

options.title: Recover safe current-attempt failures
options.body: Add a narrow current-attempt side-effect check, consume the empty-response retry or failover path when no side effect actually ran, and quarantine/log the exhausted failure path.

options.title: Keep fail-closed plus quarantine
options.body: Preserve the current no-retry safety behavior for all replay-unsafe tool turns, but persist a durable quarantine/repair record and clearer operator diagnostics.

options.title: Fold into canonical policy issue
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657 the sole canonical tracker and move this issue's cron/session-poisoning evidence there before closing or superseding this item later.

recommendation.title: Recover safe current-attempt failures
recommendation.body: Add a narrow current-attempt side-effect check, consume the empty-response retry or failover path when no side effect actually ran, and quarantine/log the exhausted failure path.
